snippet.title: G! Trailer
snippet.description:
🤯 Wishlist on Steam!
🤯 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3755190/G/?utm_source=youtube_short

G! is the hardest 2D platformer ever made, a mind-bending challenge that twists your perception of gravity, space, and movement.

Powered by a frenetic electronic soundtrack, every level is a test of skill, reflexes and sanity.

With 21 challenging levels, G! experiments with your perception and feeling of movement like never has been done before in a 2D platformer, will you be able to finish it?
#hardgames  #gaming #singleplayer #singleplayergames #2dgames #platformer #platformergames
